name: Lilsphere Rayfield
original_name: リルスフィア・レイフィード
source: The protagonist after he was reincarnated as the daughter of an upper class family. "She" was already engaged to the second Prince of the kingdom, but due to the memory as man from previous life coming back, she wants to break up the the engagement at all costs. However, her fiancé's got a better idea...
